townshend-4macc-apot: R. B. Townshend, "The Fourth Book of Maccabees," introduction and translation, in R. H. Charles, ed., The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament in English, vol. 2 (Oxford, 1913), 653-685; read in the archive.org scan apocryphapseudep02charuoft
swete-intro-4macc: H. B. egt-heb-1135: The Expositor's Greek Testament, on Hebrews 11:35 (read in the Bible Hub text)

bible-researcher-claromontanus: bible-researcher.com, the page on the list of books in Codex Claromontanus (bible-researcher.com/claromontanus.html): the Latin list with English glosses, reproduced from Westcott's General Survey of the History of the Canon of the New Testament
